ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones located centrally in both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edges and distal tips, with discrete circular mottling scattered along the leading edges and concentrated in the upper-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (5-10 pixels) compared to the more uniform jaggedness of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into narrow, pointed distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately 12-15 circular, high-contrast rings (dark perimeters with lighter interiors) localized within the white pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular rosette scarring on the right lobe and a small physical indentation/nick at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial distribution of circular ring-shaped scars forming a dense group on the right lobe's interior surface.
